info.title: OpenRoom API
info.description: Every request needs Authorization: Bearer <API key> and Content-Type: application/json, including DELETE.

get.summary: Show who this API key or session belongs to and its role.
List members with their role and last activity, and pending invites.

post.summary: Invite a member by email with a role. Returns a one-time link, valid 7 days, to send to them.

url.description: The one-time link that lets the invitee set a password. Shown only now.

emailed.description: Whether the link was emailed; otherwise send it yourself.

sendEmail.description: Email the link when email is set up. Without email, send the returned link yourself.

post.summary: Make a new invite link for a pending invite, valid another 7 days. The old link stops working.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending invite; its link stops working.

patch.summary: Change a member’s role. The last owner cannot be demoted. Their API keys follow the new role at once.

delete.summary: Remove a member: signs them out everywhere and revokes their API keys. The last owner cannot be removed.
delete.description: Needs the owner role. Destructive: without confirm: true it answers 409 with what would change.

confirm.description: Set to true only after your person agreed to the change described in the confirmation answer.

get.summary: List your own API keys. Owners can pass all: true to see every member’s keys.

start.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart.

post.summary: Create an API key for yourself. It acts with your role, looked up on every request. The key is shown only in this answer.

delete.summary: Revoke an API key; it stops working at once. Owners can revoke any member’s key.

post.summary: Remove an install-wide block by its id, or by typing the email or domain (works for erased investors).

get.summary: Show how email is set up, its last error and today’s count against the daily cap. Secrets are never shown.

source.description: env means set by the server and read only here.

hasSecret.description: Whether an API key or password is saved. It is never shown again.

put.summary: Set up email with Resend (an API key) or any SMTP server, or provider: none to turn it off. Send a test with test_email afterwards.

password.description: Left out keeps the saved password.

post.summary: Send a test email now, to you or to the address given, and report what the provider said.

get.summary: Show the domain, time zone, upload size limit and email daily cap.

domain.description: Read only; change it with openroom-server set-domain.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for dates in the admin pages and emails.

patch.summary: Change the time zone, the upload size limit (bytes) or the email daily cap.

get.summary: Show setup, free disk space, confirmed replication health and warnings. S3 and email stay optional.

post.summary: Ask the running Litestream process to sync now and wait for remote replication to finish. A running process alone is not a successful backup.
Copy and verify every retained file and received upload before switching storage. Uploads pause during the move; the old bucket is kept.
post.description: Needs the owner role. Destructive: without confirm: true it answers 409 with what would change.

confirm.description: Set to true only after your person agreed to the change described in the confirmation answer.

post.summary: Cancel an unfinished storage move. Original storage remains active; partial destination copies are retained.

get.summary: Show optional S3 storage, its last check and progress copying disk files to the bucket. Credentials are never returned.

put.summary: Test and save a private S3-compatible bucket, then copy existing disk files with checksum verification. Use move_storage to change or remove a bucket. Omitted credentials keep the saved ones.

post.summary: Write, read and delete a test object and verify an existing S3 file with the saved credentials.
Retry copying disk files into the configured S3 bucket. A disk copy is removed only after the remote size and SHA-256 match.

defaultAccess.description: Access to top-level items without their own choice, including ones added later.

post.summary: Create a viewer group in a room, such as one fund’s partners.

defaultAccess.description: Access to top-level items without their own choice, including ones added later.

put.summary: Choose whether a group sees a folder or file: view, none, or inherit (follow the parent folder or the group default). A folder’s choice covers everything in it, including files added later.

Freeze a room at the end of a deal, for good: every link is revoked, open file requests close, the room becomes read only (except its retention and deletion), and an archive is built with all files, the index, the audit log, the questions, the activity and a SHA-256 manifest.
